findings.title: The public `findMany` API was removed without migrating its callers
findings.body: `InsightsBookingService.findMany`, which previously executed the authorized query and accepted Prisma find-many arguments, has been removed and replaced by `getBaseConditions`. This is an exported service contract change, but this PR only updates this service and its test; any existing production caller invoking `service.findMany(...)` will fail TypeScript compilation (or fail at runtime for untyped consumers). Migrate all callers to an equivalent parameterized `$queryRaw` query as part of this change, or retain a compatible `findMany` method.
